About the role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer you will work directly with customers to understand their hardest technical problems, then design, build, and deploy the software that solves them. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your week is spent writing production code in the customer's environment.

What you'll do

 - Meet with customers and lead technical discovery to understand their data, systems, and constraints
 - Write production code in Python and TypeScript to build integrations between our platform and customer data sources
 - Prototype solutions quickly, then harden them into production systems you own
 - Deploy and operate what you build inside customer cloud environments
 - Debug issues across customer infrastructure, networking, and data pipelines
 - Own the implementation end-to-end, from first call to a system running in production
 - Share what you learn with our product and engineering teams

What you bring

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience owning services in production
 - Comfort working with customers when the problem is ambiguous
